scenarios.label: Scenario 1 — NI number dropped from submission

normalised_cr.title: Add National Insurance Number field to personal details form
normalised_cr.description: A new National Insurance Number input field has been added to the Step 2 Personal Details page of the benefits application form. The field is required and must be captured and included in the submitted application data.
normalised_cr.acceptance_criteria: The National Insurance Number field is displayed on the Personal Details step. The field value is validated — it must not be blank. The submitted application data includes the National Insurance Number. The confirmation page displays the National Insurance Number entered by the user.

normalised_cr.title: Fix postcode validation logic on contact information step
normalised_cr.description: The postcode input field on the Step 3 Contact Information page has had its validation regex updated. The regex now accepts a broader range of postcode formats including edge cases.
normalised_cr.acceptance_criteria: The postcode field accepts valid UK postcodes. The postcode field rejects invalid strings. An appropriate error message is shown when an invalid postcode is entered.

scenarios.label: Scenario 3 — Date of birth future-date check removed

normalised_cr.title: Update date of birth validation rules on personal details step
normalised_cr.description: The date of birth field validation on the Step 2 Personal Details page has been modified. The validation logic that checks whether the entered date is in the past has been changed.
normalised_cr.acceptance_criteria: The date of birth field accepts valid past dates. The date of birth field rejects future dates with an appropriate error message. The user cannot proceed with an invalid or future date of birth.
